description: Get canonical metadata for one geography entity such as a tract, county, ZCTA, state, or tabblock. Returns normalized IDs, labels, parent hierarchy, and source asset links.

entity_id.description: Canonical entity identifier such as '48201231400' for a tract, '48201' for a county, '77056' for a ZCTA, or '48' for a state.

entity_type.description: Optional explicit entity type such as 'tract', 'county', 'zcta', 'state', or 'tabblock'.

name: get_entity

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.

title: Get Entity
